description: lib/map.fz specs Map.put (and the put/delete/update externs and others) as returning any, where Elixir's return map. An any return makes every later protocol dispatch on the result reach every implementation, Stream included (the fz-sc8.117 small case). Tighten each Map function's spec to Elixir's return type and report any pin that moves. Lands after fz-sc8.117, which fixes the termination fault itself.
title: Map's functions say they return maps
